plan.title: Run-summary stream: one session_id, component field, ac_pass_bank envelope, no fake denominator

narratives.Description: session_id currently carries component names. ac_pass_bank lines skip the envelope. tool_turn_denominator emits total_tool_turns 1 when the host env is unset. Make the stream one identity plus a component field, wrap bank events, and stay silent when the denominator env is unset.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator reading a trial stream, I want one session identity and a uniform envelope on every line, so that envelope-keyed consumers do not drop bank events or compute a share above 100 percent.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add resolveRunSummarySessionId (option, DEFT_SESSION_ID, ritual-state, JSONL tail, mint last) and put every production emitter on it including check and dial; add optional component. 2. Emit ac_pass_bank through RunSummaryEmitter; delete JSONL sidecar writer; leave disk ledger. 3. Stop fallback-1 denominator; emit only known host/harness value with denominator_source; update #3352 text. 4. Fail-first tests + CHANGELOG.
narratives.Overview:
Issue body is authority (no comments). Wait for #3387 (session ac_pass_bank) and #3398 (clause-derivation session_id call site). Do not invent a new identity scheme beyond #3350.

#3387 and #3398 / PR #3408 are done. Implement the 2026-08-18 critique comment on #3399, not the first recommended-fix comment as written.

Locked implement note:
1. Identity: resolveRunSummarySessionId on every production emitter including check and dial. Order: explicit option, DEFT_SESSION_ID, ritual-state session_id, last session_id in destination JSONL, only then mint. Do not cite #3350 as the identity store. component is optional envelope sugar. Do not close the component union.
2. Bank: delete the JSONL sidecar writer. Emit ac_pass_bank through RunSummaryEmitter. Leave the disk ledger camelCase. Do not enroll unemitted sibling kinds. Extend #3362 fixture.
3. Denominator: kill the fallback 1. Emit only a known host/harness value, add denominator_source (harness_actual | host_planned), update #3352 procedure text. Do not claim the private collector already exports the var.
4. Rebase onto current master (#3435 already touched verify-ac/evaluate.ts; #3408 is merged). Tests: resolver + production callers with DEFT_SESSION_ID unset and ritual-state present + bank through emitter + env-unset denominator. Fake-trial alone is not enough.

items.title: One session identity and a component field

narrative.Acceptance: Given a trial stream, when every line is read, session_id is the workspace-session identity via resolveRunSummarySessionId and never the strings verify-ac or clause-derivation. Those names appear in a component field. Exactly one session identity is present.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/run-summary — session-id.test.ts + production-callers.test.ts; PR https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/3455

items.title: Bank envelope and silent unset denominator

narrative.Acceptance: Given ac_pass_bank emission, when the line is written via emitAcPassBank, it uses schema_version session_id seq ts and event ac_pass_bank plus payload. Given an unset host denominator env, when the run ends, no tool_turn_denominator event is emitted. A trial fixture asserts uniform envelope, one session identity, and silence when the env is unset. task check passes. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has a brief note.
